body_html:
The Global Sidero brings a sculpted, contemporary silhouette to multi-purpose seating that stands up to constant use. Its compound-curved back and waterfall foam seat keep visitors comfortable through long waits, while a wallsaver steel frame and stackable design make it a practical choice for busy reception areas, clinics and training rooms. Available in three seat widths, it scales from standard to bariatric without compromising the clean, coordinated look of your space.

Features

  • Compound curved back provides comfort and support across multiple seated positions.
  • Round welded steel tubing frame (7/8" diameter) with a wallsaver design that protects walls from scuffs and damage.
  • 2" high-density, highly resilient Ultracell foam with a waterfall seat edge for all-day comfort.
  • Full-length, gently curved arms in fibreglass-reinforced Nylon help stabilize users as they sit and stand.
  • Three seat widths — 19.5" standard, 24" mid-size and 30" bariatric — plus low-back and high-back options.
  • Concealed two-piece back or single-piece pullover back constructions to suit your specification.
  • Stacks for compact storage between events and reconfigurations.

Specifications

Overall dimensions measure 36.5"W x 24"D x 38.5"H for the high-back model with arms. The frame is round welded steel tubing; arms are Black (BLK) fibreglass-reinforced Nylon, and upholstery is available in multiple colours. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and structural components, 12 years on control mechanisms, and 5 years on foam, upholstery and mesh.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964) based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on the Sidero today, or call 1-800-835-9565.
